note: Colours are this archive's own, read out of its Base.astro: --disp for Leibholz, --inf for Luwinski, --doc for Figueiredo, --accent for where it ended, --ink-faint for the 1933 crossing. The kit colours markers from JavaScript, so they are hex here rather than var() and DO NOT FOLLOW THE DARK THEME the way the hand-drawn SVG did. On the map that costs nothing - the tiles are light in both themes - which is why «both» is the mid tone --ink-soft and not --ink: a near-black dot was legible on the old drawing and would vanish from the legend on a dark page.
